name: magpie-quark-checkin
description: Quark drive (夸克网盘) in magpie / OpenCode: one captured App URL reports space usage and does the daily space check-in

summary.zh: 夸克网盘接进 magpie：粘一条 App 抓包 URL（kps/sign/vcode）就能读空间占用、连签进度并每日签到领空间；不想抓包也可用网页登录只看占用。
summary.en: Quark drive in magpie: one captured App URL (kps/sign/vcode) reports space usage and does the daily space check-in; web sign-in is available for usage only.
